title: MarkSpec project manifest
description: Schema for a project's project.yaml. Unknown keys are permitted to match the loader, which ignores keys it does not recognise.

name.description: Project name. Reverse-DNS form recommended (e.g. io.driftsys.markspec).

version.description: Project version. Falls back to `git describe` when absent.

repository.description: Source repository URL. Falls back to `git remote get-url origin` when absent.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Defaults to `proprietary` when absent.

labels.description: Project-wide labels applied to every entry.

parents.description: Upstream project base URLs for federated reference resolution.

parent-fallback.description: Fallback base URL used when a parent reference cannot be resolved.

caption-conventions.description: Per-keyword caption placement: where the caption sits relative to its block.
